rules.title: No Hardcoded Secrets
rules.content: Never hardcode API keys, access tokens, or sensitive credentials in source code. Always use environment variables.

rules.title: Deterministic Sync & Path Safety
rules.content: All adapter rule outputs must be deterministically sorted by priority descending and rule ID ascending. Target paths must be strictly validated against path traversal outside the project root.

rules.title: TypeScript Strict ESM Standard
rules.content: Use NodeNext module resolution with explicit '.js' extensions in relative imports. Maintain strict type safety without 'any' where possible.
